title: Simpler Logarithmic Approximation Algorithms for the Optimal Decision Tree and Adaptive Set Cover
abstract: arXiv:2604.12036v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the problem of constructing a decision tree that identifies an unknown hypothesis from a given ground set, under both average- and worst-case cost. The Optimal Decision Tree (ODT) problem has been extensively studied in the literature, and $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$-approximation guarantees are known for each criterion, including a simultaneous guarantee for both (here $n$ is the number of hypotheses) [ICML]. Although most of the existing algorithm use simple greedy strategies, their analyses rely on intricate arguments. Since ODT is a fundamental problem with wide-ranging applications, we are interested in developing algorithms that are both effective and easy to understand.   We present a new greedy algorithm with a simplified analysis that simultaneously achieves approximation factors below $3.65\log_2 n$ for worst-case cost and $7.3\log_2 n$ for average-case cost. translated_title: 更简单的最优决策树与自适应集合覆盖的对数近似算法
translated_abstract: 我们研究在平均代价和最坏情形代价两种准则下，构造能够从给定基集中识别未知假设的决策树问题。最优决策树问题在文献中已被广泛研究，针对每种准则均已有 $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$ 近似保证的结果，其中也包括同时对两种准则的保证（此处 $n$ 为假设的数量）[ICML]。尽管现有的大多数算法采用了简单的贪心策略，但它们的分析依赖于复杂的论证。由于 ODT 是一个具有广泛应用的基础问题，我们希望开发既有效又易于理解的算法。我们提出了一种新的贪心算法并给出了简化分析，该算法同时实现了最坏情形代价下低于 $3.65\log_2 n$、平均情形代价下低于 $7.3\log_2 n$ 的近似因子。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种带有简化分析的新贪心算法，为最优决策树问题同时实现了最坏情形代价低于 $3.65\log_2 n$ 和平均情形代价低于 $7.3\log_2 n$ 的对数近似保证。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a new greedy algorithm with a simplified analysis that simultaneously achieves approximation factors below $3.65\log_2 n$ for worst-case cost and $7.3\log_2 n$ for average-case cost for the Optimal Decision Tree problem.
